info.name: Beat-X Complete API Collection
info.description:
Verified, complete, and production-grade Postman collection for the Beat-X backend API (v1.0), synchronized with the OpenAPI specification (http://13.200.168.40:3000/api/docs).

Organized by user role and domain lifecycle:
• Auth — public registration, email verification OTP, login, tokens, password reset.
• USER — authenticated user workflows, settings, profile, and public content browsing.
• ARTIST — creator tools, verification onboarding tabs, songs, videos, podcasts, merch, support tickets.
• ADMIN — platform oversight, moderation queues, content management, analytics, payouts, and scheduled jobs.

All emojis (✅, ❌, ⚠️) are preserved at the start of names. All parameters and bodies conform strictly to backend DTOs.

request.description: Replace otp with the 6-digit code received after Register. On success this logs the user in immediately and returns tokens — this request also stores them into userAccessToken / userRefreshToken.

item.description:
Public account flows shared by every role: register, verify email (OTP), forgot/reset password, refresh, logout.

Admin accounts CANNOT self-register — there is no public endpoint for it. Register a normal user, verify it, then manually change that user's "role" field to "admin" in MongoDB. After that, use the Admin folder's own Login request.

Run requests in this folder top-to-bottom (numbered) once per role before moving on to the role folders below.
